hero.title: A production-shaped cluster,
hero.titleAccent: run by one person who is still learning it.
hero.blurb: I'm a sysadmin moving into DevOps, and this homelab is where the KubeCraft course meets real hardware. Three nodes, two CPU architectures, GitOps with Flux, secrets encrypted in the repo, and a public app behind a Cloudflare Tunnel. Everything below links to the commit or the post that proves it, including the parts that went wrong.

contact.name: Craven Craven
contact.headline: Open to DevOps and SRE roles.
contact.line: Happy to walk through the cluster live and show you how a change gets from git to running.
